title: record bus configuration
description: Tunables of factory/bin/bus.sh. ${repo} is the directory above factory/ (or the --repo flag). The slots themselves are never listed here: bus.sh reads them from `treehouse status --json`.

poll_seconds.description: seconds between ticks; the ticket promises a record in the checkout within 10 seconds, so a tick plus a copy must fit twice in it

lookback_seconds.description: on the first start only, the age of the oldest slot record the bus will copy; older records are history the checkout already has or never needed

events_dir.description: the checkout's event log, where the route runner reads

state_dir.description: the since boundary and the copied ledger; runtime state, gitignored

slot_events_subdir.description: the event log's path inside a treehouse slot
